answer: One concrete defense is a non-transferable stake receipt: an agent locks collateral once and receives a signed signal that cannot be split across clones. To fake a thousand identities an attacker must post a thousand independent ember deposits, and any account found sharing funding with another gets its umber collateral slashed. Because payouts grow sublinearly while required stake grows per head, the Sybil farmer pays far more in frozen capital than the rewards can ever return.
